title: ZapConfig
description: Configuration schema for zap minimal prompt with full styling support

$schema.description: Path or URL to JSON schema for validation and autocompletion

format.description: Root prompt format string controlling module layout, inline styling blocks [content](style), and escaped characters (e.g. \$ for literal '$')

add_newline.description: Insert a blank line before the prompt

format.description: Format template for the directory module

style.description: Style string for the directory path

home_symbol.description: Replacement symbol for the user home directory

read_only.description: Symbol shown when the current directory is read-only (Nerd Font icon)

read_only_style.description: Style string for the read-only symbol

truncation_length.description: Number of directory path segments to display before truncation (0 = disable)

truncation_symbol.description: Symbol replacing truncated parent directory path segments

truncate_to_repo.description: Whether to truncate path relative to the root of the current Git repository

format.description: Format template for the git_branch module

symbol.description: Symbol preceding the git branch name

style.description: Style string for the branch text

truncation_length.description: Maximum character length for branch name before truncation (0 = disable)

truncation_symbol.description: Symbol appended when branch name is truncated

git_commit.description: Git commit hash and tag rendering configuration

format.description: Format template for the git_commit module

style.description: Style string for the commit hash and tag

commit_hash_length.description: Number of characters to display from the commit hash (0 = full SHA)

only_detached.description: Only display git_commit when HEAD is detached

git_state.description: Git operation state (merge, rebase, cherry-pick) rendering configuration

format.description: Format template for the git_state module

style.description: Style string for the state text

rebase.description: Label shown when a rebase is in progress

merge.description: Label shown when a merge is in progress

revert.description: Label shown when a revert is in progress

cherry_pick.description: Label shown when a cherry-pick is in progress

bisect.description: Label shown when a bisect is in progress

am.description: Label shown when applying mailbox patches

am_or_rebase.description: Label shown when applying mailbox patches or rebasing

format.description: Format template for the git_status module

staged.description: Symbol shown when changes are staged

modified.description: Symbol shown when files are modified

untracked.description: Symbol shown when untracked files exist

renamed.description: Symbol shown when files are renamed

deleted.description: Symbol shown when files are deleted

stashed.description: Symbol shown when stashed changes exist

ahead.description: Symbol shown when local branch is ahead of remote

behind.description: Symbol shown when local branch is behind remote

diverged.description: Symbol shown when local and remote branches have diverged

conflicted.description: Symbol shown when merge conflicts exist

up_to_date.description: Symbol shown when repository is clean and up to date

min_time.description: Minimum execution duration in milliseconds required to render the module

format.description: Format template for the cmd_duration module

style.description: Style string for the duration text

show_milliseconds.description: Display milliseconds when execution time is under a minute

format.description: Format template for the character module

success_symbol.description: Symbol rendered when the exit code is 0 (supports [symbol](style))

error_symbol.description: Symbol rendered on non-zero exit code (supports [symbol](style))

format.description: Format template for the os module

style.description: Style string for the os logo

symbol.description: Custom OS symbol override. If omitted or empty, automatically detected based on the current OS/distribution.

Style.description: Style string combining modifiers, foreground/background colors, 8-bit ANSI (0-255), and 24-bit TrueColor Hex (#RGB / #RRGGBB). Examples: 'bold cyan', 'bold italic fg:#50fa7b bg:#282a36', 'underline bg:#bf5700 fg:white', '240', 'bold fg:27'.
